<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>SIAC | Sistema Inteligente de Alertas y Seguimiento</title>
<style>
:root{--navy:#083b66;--blue:#0879c9;--cyan:#19a8d8;--green:#12a36b;--red:#e84c4c;--yellow:#f3b928;--bg:#f3f7fa;--text:#17324d;--muted:#718397;--card:#fff;--line:#e2eaf0;--shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(20,56,86,.08)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;font-family:Inter,Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text)}
.app{display:flex;min-height:100vh}.sidebar{width:225px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#073c67,#052e50);color:#fff;padding:20px 14px;position:fixed;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;z-index:5}.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-weight:800;font-size:18px;padding:6px 9px 24px}.brand .logo{width:34px;height:34px;background:#fff;border-radius:9px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--green);font-size:20px}.brand small{display:block;font-size:9px;font-weight:500;opacity:.75;margin-top:2px}.nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}.nav button{border:0;background:transparent;color:#cfe3f2;text-align:left;padding:12px 13px;border-radius:8px;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px}.nav button:hover,.nav button.active{background:#087cba;color:#fff}.nav .badge{margin-left:auto;background:#e84c4c;color:white;border-radius:20px;padding:2px 7px;font-size:10px}.main{margin-left:225px;width:calc(100% - 225px)}.topbar{height:58px;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;padding:0 28px;gap:20px}.topbar .user{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:13px}.avatar{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:#dcebf5;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--navy);font-weight:700}.content{padding:25px 30px 40px;max-width:1500px;margin:auto}.welcome{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:20px}.welcome h1{font-size:21px;margin:0 0 6px}.welcome p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}.date{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);background:#fff;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:14px;margin-bottom:18px}.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}.metric{padding:15px;min-height:104px}.metric .label{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}.metric .value{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;margin:9px 0 3px;color:var(--navy)}.metric .sub{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}.metric .sub.up{color:var(--red)}.metric .sub.good{color:var(--green)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr 1fr;gap:15px;margin-bottom:18px}.panel{padding:17px}.panel h3{font-size:14px;margin:0 0 14px}.panel-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}.small{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}
.chart{height:205px;position:relative;border-left:1px solid #dfe8ee;border-bottom:1px solid #dfe8ee;background:repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 0,transparent 40px,#eef3f6 41px)}.bars{height:100%;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-around;padding:0 10px 0}.bar-group{height:100%;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:3px;position:relative}.bar{width:14px;border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;background:#1487c7;min-height:5px}.bar.paid{background:#36b37e}.month{position:absolute;bottom:-19px;left:0;font-size:9px;color:#8495a3}.donut-wrap{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;height:190px}.donut{width:130px;height:130px;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(#d94b4b 0 55%,#f2bb36 55% 73%,#2ca978 73% 100%);position:relative}.donut:after{content:"SIAC";position:absolute;inset:24px;background:#fff;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:14px;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy)}.legend{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-left:16px;font-size:10px}.dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block;margin-right:5px}.risk-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}.risk{padding:11px;border-radius:8px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:11px}.risk strong{font-size:16px}.risk.high{background:#fff0f0;border-left:4px solid var(--red)}.risk.med{background:#fff8e6;border-left:4px solid var(--yellow)}.risk.low{background:#ebfaf4;border-left:4px solid var(--green)}
.section{margin-top:5px}.toolbar{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px}.toolbar input,.toolbar select{border:1px solid #d6e2ea;background:#fff;border-radius:7px;padding:9px 11px;font-size:12px;outline:none}.toolbar input{flex:1;min-width:190px}.btn{border:0;border-radius:7px;padding:9px 13px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700}.btn.primary{background:#0782c7;color:#fff}.btn.green{background:#0e9e69;color:#fff}.btn.light{background:#edf5f9;color:#17608a}.btn:hover{filter:brightness(.96)}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px}th{background:#f5f8fa;color:#607587;text-align:left;font-weight:700;padding:11px 9px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}td{padding:11px 9px;border-bottom:1px solid #edf1f4;vertical-align:middle}.status{padding:4px 7px;border-radius:12px;font-size:9px;font-weight:800}.status.vencida{background:#ffe9e9;color:#c73838}.status.conc{background:#fff4d8;color:#9b6b00}.status.pagada{background:#e4f7ef;color:#08764e}.risk-tag{padding:4px 8px;border-radius:12px;font-size:9px;font-weight:800}.risk-tag.Alto{background:#ffe8e8;color:#c52d2d}.risk-tag.Medio{background:#fff3d1;color:#986900}.risk-tag.Bajo{background:#e2f6ed;color:#08764e}.actions button{border:0;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;color:#0879c9;font-size:16px}.alerts{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}.alert{border-left:4px solid var(--red);padding:10px 11px;background:#fff5f5;border-radius:6px;font-size:10px}.alert strong{display:block;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:3px}.ai-box{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#edf8ff,#f2fbf8);border:1px solid #cde8f5;border-radius:9px;padding:14px}.ai-box h4{margin:0 0 7px;color:var(--navy);font-size:12px}.ai-box p{margin:0;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;color:#4e6678}.footer-note{font-size:10px;color:#8a9aa8;margin-top:10px}.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(2,30,48,.55);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:20}.modal.show{display:flex}.modal-card{background:#fff;width:min(560px,92vw);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.25);padding:22px}.modal-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}.modal-head h2{font-size:18px;margin:0}.close{border:0;background:#edf3f7;border-radius:50%;width:30px;height:30px;cursor:pointer}.form{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-top:17px}.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}.field.full{grid-column:1/-1}.field label{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:#5c7283}.field input,.field select{padding:10px;border:1px solid #d8e3ea;border-radius:7px;font-size:12px}.modal-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;margin-top:18px}.toast{position:fixed;right:25px;bottom:25px;background:#063b65;color:#fff;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;display:none;z-index:30;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}.toast.show{display:block}
@media(max-width:1000px){.sidebar{width:72px}.brand span,.brand small,.nav button span{display:none}.nav button{justify-content:center}.main{margin-left:72px;width:calc(100% - 72px)}.cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.content{padding:20px}.topbar{padding:0 15px}}
@media(max-width:600px){.cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}.form{grid-template-columns:1fr}.field.full{grid-column:auto}.table-wrap{overflow:auto}}

.brand .logo{width:48px;height:48px;flex:0 0 48px;background:#062e4e;border:1px solid #55cbb3;border-radius:13px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 5px 18px #031e3370}
.brand .logo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transform:scale(1.13)}
.brand-tag{font-style:normal;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.4px;color:#80e0c1;vertical-align:middle;margin-left:4px}
.brand{align-items:center;padding-bottom:26px}.brand small{max-width:140px;line-height:1.4}
.hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(circle at 85% 15%,#1a9e9870,transparent 32%),linear-gradient(125deg,#062e4e,#0b5575 58%,#087d7a);color:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:34px 36px;min-height:260px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px #06375524}
.hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:290px;height:290px;border:1px solid #b6fff42b;border-radius:50%;right:8%;top:-90px;box-shadow:0 0 0 24px #b6fff40a,0 0 0 52px #b6fff408}
.hero-copy{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:660px}.eyebrow{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#a9f4d7;font-weight:800}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(25px,3vw,38px);line-height:1.13;margin:12px 0}.hero p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;color:#d5eaf2;max-width:590px;margin:0 0 20px}
.hero-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}.hero .btn{padding:12px 16px}.hero .btn.primary{background:#43d5a1;color:#063d50}.hero .btn.light{background:#ffffff18;color:white;border:1px solid #ffffff40}
.hero-logo{position:relative;z-index:1;width:min(29%,250px);min-width:130px;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 25px #001a3080)}
.home-strip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:18px}.home-tile{padding:18px;display:flex;gap:13px;align-items:flex-start}.tile-icon{width:42px;height:42px;flex:0 0 42px;border-radius:12px;background:#e8f7f4;color:#087c75;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:20px}
.home-tile h3{font-size:13px;margin:2px 0 6px}.home-tile p{font-size:11px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--muted);margin:0}
.home-foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;align-items:center;margin-top:18px;padding:15px 18px;border:1px solid #d7e9e8;background:#f5fbfa;border-radius:10px;font-size:11px;color:#496777}
.data-note{font-size:10px;color:#8a9aa8;line-height:1.5;margin-top:12px}.report-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:15px}
.report-summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px;margin-top:18px}
@media(max-width:750px){.hero{padding:25px;min-height:0}.hero-logo{width:100px;min-width:100px}.home-strip{grid-template-columns:1fr}.report-summary{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media print{.sidebar,.topbar,.toolbar,.report-actions,.btn,.hero-actions{display:none!important}.main{margin:0;width:100%}.content{padding:0}.page{display:none!important}#reportes{display:block!important}}

/* Extensión interactiva académica: conserva la interfaz base */
.info-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:12px;margin-top:14px}.info-card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;padding:14px;background:#fff}.info-card h4{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:12px;color:var(--navy)}.info-card p{margin:0;font-size:10px;line-height:1.55;color:#617789}.mini-table{margin-top:12px}.mini-table td,.mini-table th{font-size:10px}.explain{background:#f7fbfd;border-left:4px solid var(--cyan);padding:11px 13px;border-radius:7px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;margin-top:12px}.kpi-detail{display:none;margin-top:8px;font-size:10px;line-height:1.5;color:#5b7182}.info-card.open .kpi-detail{display:block}.clickable{cursor:pointer}.clickable:hover{box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(20,56,86,.10)}@media(max-width:750px){.info-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* Dashboard gerencial tipo Power BI - agregado sin cambiar la estructura visual */
.dash-toolbar{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin:14px 0}.dash-toolbar select{border:1px solid #d6e2ea;background:#fff;border-radius:7px;padding:9px 11px;font-size:12px}.dash-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr 1fr;gap:15px;margin-top:15px}.dash-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:17px}.dash-card h3{font-size:13px;margin:0 0 12px}.hbar-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px 1fr 75px;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:9px 0;font-size:10px}.hbar-track{height:13px;background:#edf3f7;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden}.hbar-fill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0879c9,#19a8d8);border-radius:8px}.stack{height:24px;display:flex;border-radius:7px;overflow:hidden;background:#edf3f7;margin:14px 0}.stack span{display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;min-width:1px}.stack .s1{background:#e84c4c}.stack .s2{background:#f3b928}.stack .s3{background:#12a36b}.aging{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:9px}.aging-box{background:#f6f9fb;border:1px solid #e3ebf0;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;text-align:center}.aging-box b{display:block;font-size:18px;color:#083b66;margin-bottom:4px}.aging-box span{font-size:9px;color:#718397}.dash-table{max-height:290px;overflow:auto}.dash-note{margin-top:12px;background:#edf8ff;border-left:4px solid #0879c9;padding:11px;border-radius:6px;font-size:10px;line-height:1.5;color:#4e6678}@media(max-width:900px){.dash-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.aging{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}

.user-switcher{position:relative}.user-trigger{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--text);font:inherit;cursor:pointer;padding:5px 7px;border-radius:9px}.user-trigger:hover{background:#f1f6f9}.user-menu{display:none;position:absolute;right:0;top:46px;width:260px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(10,49,78,.18);padding:8px;z-index:50}.user-menu.show{display:block}.user-menu-title{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:#718397;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.7px;padding:8px 9px}.user-menu button{width:100%;border:0;background:transparent;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-align:left;padding:9px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text)}.user-menu button:hover{background:#edf7fb}.user-menu button span:last-child{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}.user-menu button small{font-size:9px;color:#8092a1}.mini-avatar{width:30px;height:30px;flex:0 0 30px;border-radius:50%;background:#dcebf5;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--navy);font-size:10px;font-weight:800}.user-menu-note{font-size:9px;line-height:1.45;color:#718397;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:9px;margin-top:4px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="app">
<aside class="sidebar">
  <div class="brand"><div class="logo"><img alt="Logo SIAC" src="data:image/png;base64,
